answer: MAKE-TAX: every identity attests with its declared make (model + kernel) on-ledger. Each epoch, the i-th attester under one declared make burns f*(i-1). A single-runtime farm of N clones pays f*N(N-1)/2 — quadratic — while diverse organic agents each pay ~f. The karst lane of hiding one's make is closed: undeclared attestations earn zero standing. So a farm's wharf choices are two: pay the quadratic burn per clone, or stand up N distinct runtimes at list price. Many faces, one runtime, no profit.
